body.cap: AVING News conducted an interview with Kwangsuk Seo, Co-CEO of Sungmin Networks, at the AVING Media Stage set up in the Seoul Pavilion at Eureka Park, Venetian Expo, during CES 2026. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Sungmin Networks Co., Ltd. (CEOs Myung-il Cha and Kwangsuk Seo) participated in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and technology exhibition held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9 (local time), and conducted an interview at the AVING Media Stage inside the Seoul Pavilion during the exhibition period.

Founded in 2009 with the goal of leading digital innovation in medical settings, Sungmin Networks is a hospital CRM (Customer Relationship Management) specialist. The company provides customized CRM solutions for specialty hospitals such as dermatology, plastic surgery, ophthalmology, and dentistry, offering services that optimize overall hospital operations, including reservations, reception, and clinical workflow integration.

In particular, Sungmin Networks’ proprietary platform, “TalkCRM,” has received positive reviews for maximizing hospital customer management efficiency through AI-based automation and real-time data analysis, thereby accelerating digital transformation across medical settings.

At CES 2026, TalkCRM was selected as an Innovation Award winner in the Artificial Intelligence category, gaining recognition for its global-level competitiveness. Building on this achievement, Sungmin Networks also signed an MOU with a medical institution in North America to conduct local proof-of-concept projects, successfully laying the groundwork for global market entry.

Introduced again at CES 2026 as the company’s flagship solution, TalkCRM is a platform that digitizes the entire medical service lifecycle, from reservations and reception to treatment and consultation, enhancing both operational efficiency for hospitals and convenience for patients. According to the company, TalkCRM supports patient data management and hospital marketing simultaneously through AI-based automation and EMR integration, contributing to innovation in patient experience.

Specifically, consultation management and automation features based on CTI (Computer Telephony Integration) and AICC (AI Contact Center) enable 24-hour customer response, reducing the burden on hospital staff while improving patient satisfaction.

In addition, TalkCRM operates as a cloud-based SaaS solution, enabling scalable expansion tailored to a hospital’s physical size and workforce. It also supports integration with hospital websites, mobile apps, and SNS databases for network-wide management. Furthermore, the platform provides integrated solutions such as session tracking, quotations, and discount management tailored to each medical specialty, as well as API integration with InBody systems for obesity management.

Kwangsuk Seo, Co-CEO of Sungmin Networks, said, “TalkCRM comprehensively supports hospital operations by covering functions such as patient reservation and reception management, EMR integration, and consultation automation.” He added, “This allows medical institutions to manage patients more efficiently and allocate more resources to treatment and care, ultimately improving the quality of medical services.”

Seo continued, “Sungmin Networks is expanding cooperation with global medical institutions to verify TalkCRM’s applicability overseas, while pursuing localization to provide solutions tailored to each country’s medical environment and regulations worldwide.” He added, “Our participation in CES and the Innovation Award win are expected to serve as key drivers in accelerating this global expansion strategy.”

The company participated in CES 2026, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-focused exhibition area. The Seoul Pavilion at CES 2026 supported a total of 70 startups with participation from 19 startup support organizations based in Seoul, including the Seoul Business Agency, district offices, related institutions, and universities. The 70 exhibiting companies were composed of startups offering products and services based on advanced technologies such as AI, mobility, and healthcare. Among them, selected outstanding companies were given the opportunity to participate in CES’s official media event, Unveiled.
